strategy.audience: Parents of toddlers aged 2-5 who experience high-stress, prolonged bedtime battles and feel exhausted by the nightly routine.
strategy.core_insight: Bedtime tantrums are rarely about defiance; they are about transition anxiety, which can be instantly defused by giving the child a microscopic sense of control before the routine even starts.
strategy.reasoning: Parents struggling with bedtime tantrums are deeply fatigued and need an immediate, actionable fix rather than theoretical advice. A curiosity gap hook leverages the unusual 'two-minute rule' to grab their attention instantly, while the problem-agitate-solve structure validates their daily exhaustion before delivering the practical solution clearly.

hook_candidates.text: This weird two minute trick completely ended our nightly toddler bedtime screaming matches.
Why giving your toddler just two minutes of control stops bedtime tantrums instantly.
My four year old used to fight bedtime until we tried this exact rule.
